events.brook-first-appearance: The Straw Hats find Brook, a talking skeleton, on a ghost ship in the Florian Triangle; Luffy invites him to join.
events.arrival-at-thriller-bark: The Thousand Sunny gets trapped at Thriller Bark, and Nami, Usopp and Chopper go ashore on the island.
events.gecko-moria-first-appearance: Gecko Moria appears, a Shichibukai and master of Thriller Bark, with his power to steal shadows.
events.shadows-stolen: Moria steals the shadows of Luffy, Zoro and Sanji; Luffy's goes into Oars's body.
events.oars-revived: Oars, the ancient demonic giant, awakens with Luffy's shadow.
events.brook-vs-ryuma: Brook faces the zombie Ryuma, who carries his shadow, and loses.
events.sanji-vs-absalom: Sanji interrupts Absalom's fake wedding to Nami and fights him.
events.usopp-vs-perona: Usopp, immune to the Negative Hollows, defeats Perona.
events.zoro-vs-ryuma: Zoro defeats Ryuma on the rooftop and obtains the sword Shusui.
events.chopper-robin-vs-hogback: Chopper and Robin defeat Hogback and Cindry.
events.nami-vs-absalom: Nami defeats Absalom with Thunderbolt Tempo.
events.straw-hat-docking: Franky, Usopp and Chopper attempt the Straw Hat "Docking" against Oars.
events.bartholomew-kuma-arrival: Bartholomew Kuma, a Shichibukai, arrives at Thriller Bark.
events.nightmare-luffy: Luffy absorbs 100 stolen shadows and becomes Nightmare Luffy.
events.luffy-vs-oars: Nightmare Luffy and the crew defeat Oars.
events.shadows-asgard: Moria absorbs 1000 shadows and becomes Shadow's Asgard.
events.luffy-vs-gecko-moria: Luffy defeats Gecko Moria with Gear Second and Gear Third at dawn.
events.zoro-vs-kuma: Kuma defeats the exhausted crew with Ursus Shock.
events.nothing-happened: Zoro takes on all of Luffy's pain to save him: "Nothing happened."
events.brook-past-rumbar-pirates: Brook tells of his past with the Rumbar Pirates and his promise to Laboon.
events.binks-sake: Brook plays Bink's Sake with the Straw Hats and the freed people of Thriller Bark.
events.brook-joins-crew: Brook joins the Straw Hats as musician.
events.brook-bounty-33m: Brook's wanted poster is shown: 33,000,000 berries.
